description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various models on the Overall ROUGE-G Score as a function of the number of training examples, specifically comparing PELMS against other methods such as Pegasus-X, Primera, and Centrum, with some variants using only 5% of the training data. The x-axis, labeled “# Training Examples,” is linear and spans from 0 to 64, with major tick marks at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis, labeled “Overall ROUGE-G Score,” is linear and ranges from 11.0 to 19.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.0 (11.0, 13.0, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0). The solid green line with circle markers (PELMS) starts at approximately 16.8 at 0 examples, rises to 18.8 at 16 examples, and plateaus near 18.9 at 64 examples. The dashed green line (PELMS (5%)) follows a similar upward trend, starting at 16.8 and reaching 18.2 at 64 examples. The solid red line (Primera) begins at 15.0, increases to 17.3 at 16 examples, and reaches 18.4 at 64 examples. The dashed red line (Primera (5%)) starts at 15.0, dips slightly to 14.7 at 16 examples, then recovers to 15.8 at 64 examples. The solid blue line (Pegasus-X) begins at 13.5, drops to 11.5 at 16 examples, then rises to 14.2 at 64 examples. The dashed blue line (Pegasus-X (5%)) starts at 13.5, falls to 11.5 at 16 examples, and ends at 14.2 at 64 examples. The solid yellow line (Centrum) begins at 15.8, rises slightly to 16.0 at 16 examples, and reaches 16.5 at 64 examples. The dashed yellow line (Centrum (5%)) starts at 15.8, dips to 15.5 at 16 examples, then recovers to 16.0 at 64 examples.
